method.state_accuracy: fraction of labelled turns whose predicted state matches gold (per item mean and memory-pooled)
method.valid_set_exact: predicted ACTIVE labelled-turn set equals gold ACTIVE set
method.evidence_recall: fraction of labelled turns represented by any unit in the merged context
method.missing_policy: a labelled turn with no unit in the merged context is MISSING and counts as wrong

limitations: Offline hash embedding is not semantic; the extractive answer is not an LLM answer.
The benchmark has 17 annotated items across conv-26/30/41/42 (6 with an as_of date); it is a custom reference set, not a held-out test split.
U1/U2/U3 use offline_slot/state resolvers; as_of items cannot be fully respected by offline_slot.
State labels are turn-level; mapping to module fact units uses evidence spans, so a turn with no fact unit is MISSING.
All 17 benchmark items have labels, so no NULL state_accuracy rows occur here; the code writes NULL for an unannotated item.
A-level interface metric only; no answer F1 and no Judge.
